visualOrderRules.scope: Raw slots first; rearrange these leading slots only after decoding. Suffix slots remain in their existing order. No other marks are normalized by these rules. Raw orphan flags are retained and do not themselves mean an error.

visualOrderEvidenceMethod: All observed page-stream runs under provisional seed values. Compares raw orphan flags to flags after applying only the four shared patterns; unknown/empty byte values are boundaries. Pattern matches and changes in flags are evidence of visual order, not verification of byte meanings or overall accuracy. Form XObjects are not scanned.

aaVowelEvidence.scope: Applied to Ayar/WinInnwa legacy conversion after visual-order rearrangement; raw scoring probes bypass it. The raw glyph mappings remain subset-specific.
aaVowelEvidence.userRule: When an ါ/ာ-bearing syllable has ျ or ြ, use ာ rather than the default ါ, e.g. ဂါ / ဂျာ. Preserve the distinct Unicode code points.
aaVowelEvidence.limitations: Initials in stacked syllables need not be the vowel-bearing consonant; other medials and stacks are separate cases. Dictionary evidence is not exhaustive. This is separate from selecting a glyph variant of ု; ဒု remains short and ငြု uses the long variant.
aaVowelEvidence.implementation: JS legacyAyarToUnicode and Python legacy_ayar_to_unicode; the partial single-cluster raw encoders also apply the rule. The partial raw decoders remain unwired.
